correctness.rationale: An accepted deposition blocks future cross-interval interactions. For a vacant segment of length m>=2 with occupied endpoints, the two edge vacancies have accepted rate 1/2 each and the m-2 interior vacancies rate 1 each, yielding exact first-success recurrences. Their difference equals 1/(m-1)!, and a formal generating-function ODE solves to A(z)=(e^{-z}/(1-z)^2-e^z)/2. The first ring deposition leaves a same-species interval of length L-1, giving the exact stated expression. The finite-size difference is strictly positive for all L>=3. A local-minimum-of-first-clock barrier argument establishes the line limit. A standalone exact independent finite-state calculation passed 324 rational comparisons.

originality.rationale: The main ring expression was conjectured numerically by Martins-Dickman-Ziff (2022), and is explicitly acknowledged as prior. Their discussion does not provide a proof. The work supplies the all-size proof, two new boundary-conditioned generating functions, strict finite-size monotonicity, and factorial error. The 2023 one-attempt AB model is not dynamically equivalent; 2005 monomer/dimer processes do not state the claimed process. Published-record searches and recoverable own history did not identify stronger coverage, subject to the stated residual risks.
